title: The Prism on the Pencil
youtube_title: The Prism on the Pencil | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet noticing is a way of being gentle with the world.
summary: At a library aisle with a slice of sun, Sable finds a broken glass-bead prism on a pencil, throwing specks. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Sable shows Chioma how to look without disturbing it. Nana Ruth looks too, and they leave it where it is.
